mentions.name: ParaQuery
mentions.description: A zero-hassle package for GPU-accelerated SQL and Spark data processing, running in production for a few months. It recently processed 900TB with roughly 5x efficiency compared to the customer's previous BigQuery setup.
mentions.problem: Large-scale data processing was significantly less efficient on the customer's previous BigQuery setup.
